# egloballearning

> egloballearning is a DEIB consulting and corporate training firm specializing in diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging strategies for organizations.

Global Learning provides comprehensive DEIB consulting services, learning and development programs, data analysis, and website accessibility solutions to help organizations build inclusive workplace cultures. The firm serves Fortune 500 and Fortune 100 companies across North America with expertise in strategic planning, diversity training, and compliance with accessibility standards like WCAG, ADA, and AODA.

## Key Topics

- DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging)
- Strategic Planning
- Diversity Training
- Workplace Culture
- Organizational Development
- Data Analysis
- Website Accessibility
- WCAG/ADA/AODA Compliance
- Corporate Training
- Inclusion Programs
- Belonging Framework
- DEI Services
- Consulting
- Employee Analysis
- Cultural Awareness

## Core Services

- [DEIB Strategic Planning & Consulting](https://www.egloballearning.com/deib-strategic-planning-consulting): Core DEIB strategic planning and consulting service offerings
- [Learning & Development](https://www.egloballearning.com/learning-development): Diversity training, virtual workshops, and customized L&D programs
- [Data Collection and Analysis](https://www.egloballearning.com/data-analysis): DEIB data collection and employee analysis service for organizational optimization
- [Website Accessibility](https://www.egloballearning.com/website-accessibility): Website accessibility audits and WCAG, AODA, ADA compliance solutions
